messages:
Kevin (Sales): Heads-up: Medirev's security team requested end-to-end evidence for the POC before we flip Dedicated. They want: audit export of API key lifecycle, per-request logs with requester IP and request_id, delivery proof to their SIEM, and a certificate that keys were revoked at POC end. Can we deliver from Hosted or do we need Dedicated?
Mira (Eng): Hosted can produce everything they asked for except customer-managed CMKs. We can run a scoped export (start/end dates) that includes admin key events and daily jsonl for requests. We can also produce a revocation record at the end.
Tom (Security): For legal they need a signed "evidence certificate" (PDF) describing what was exported, redaction rules, and a SHA256 checksum of the export files so they can verify integrity. Also confirm KMS metadata: key origin, rotation cadence, and whether keys live in HSM.
Alex (SE): Delivery options: Splunk HEC, cross-account S3 write (we'll create a role), or secure SFTP. For Splunk we stream on ingest; for S3 we upload daily gzipped jsonl and include a manifest.json containing file checksums. Example S3 manifest line: {"file":"2026-03-15-logs.jsonl.gz","sha256":"abcd..."}.
poc-bot: Provisioned medirev-poc-hosted-02 (expires 2026-04-20)
Mira (Eng): For rotation/revoke evidence we'll export a CSV with columns: key_id, op, actor, ts, job_id, old_hash, new_hash, ticket. We never export plaintext secrets. I'll redact hashes to first 12 chars per policy.
Tom (Security): I'll prepare the attestation text and add SOC2 references plus a short appendix on redaction and operator identity (Okta SSO). We'll sign the PDF and include the export SHA256.
Kevin (Sales): Great. Medirev prefers S3 but can accept Splunk. I'll ask for S3 bucket ARN and write-role details. Can we have the export + attestation ready in 48 hours?
Mira (Eng): Yes if we get delivery creds in 24 hours. If not, we can provide a secure SFTP link and upload. I'll draft the revocation runbook too.
Alex (SE): I'll assemble a README mapping each exported field to the questionnaire items and include a network diagram showing egress IPs and endpoints.
Kevin (Sales): Thanks team — I'll ping carol@medirev.com now for S3 details and CMK preference.
Tom (Security): One more note: include a tamper-evident seal on the bundle (signed manifest) and a short note about retention policy (we keep hosted logs 180 days, can produce 90-day scoped export).
